clips.video: QuickTime, H.264 High, 1620x1080, ~29.92 fps average (variable), no audio, 10.8 GB
clips.notes: Rocket-style lamp: orange/red wax in violet liquid, silver base and nose cone. Recording starts from cold, so it covers the full warm-up and about 85 minutes of steady cycling. No cool-down. Camera drifts slowly (about 40 px left and 100 px up over the recording, plus slight zoom/tilt), so frames are stabilized against the lamp body before masking.
